Katy Perry objects to White House using her song in military video

Singer Katy Perry has expressed strong disapproval of the White House using her song 'Firework' in a TikTok video that depicted military strikes. Perry stated that the use of her music was a violation of the song's message of hope and healing. She conveyed that she was 'deeply appalled and angry' by the administration's action. The video reportedly featured footage of military strikes.
